shopperNeeds.goal: Find one light for a table beside the bed. Judge its basic table-light function from public information, without assuming battery runtime or an electrical safety certification.

hardConstraints.label: Item price must be at most $70; delivery is outside this budget.

preferences.label: Prefer a table light rather than an unrelated household item.

recommenderContext.query: a light for my bedside table up to $70

instructions: Navigate in actual headed Chrome; inspect products and select a product/color using the visible store.
Private shopper needs guide your choice. Only assigned observable context may be entered into search or sent to the recommender; do not reveal private needs there.
The generic arm retains the store's existing deterministic query/search behavior; it is not a blank-query or no-personalization control.

Report actual actions and any failure honestly. A fresh Chrome tab does not imply fresh cookies or isolated storage.
